checks.valid_references: Every asset_id and item_id resolves within the same run and every artifact matches schema version 1.
checks.requested_k: top_k counts SelectionItem identifiers, not member source assets.
checks.complete_accounting: Every asset has exactly one assessment and every selection item has exactly one decision.
